snippet.title: DELHI VLOG: Dilli Ka Street Food & Markets | Connaught Place to Jama Masjid | RAMSHA SULTAN
snippet.description:
Welcome to Dilwalo Ki Dilli, the heart of India 🇮🇳. In this video, I take you through some of the most iconic, aesthetic, and soulful spots of New Delhi and Old Delhi — from the colonial charm of Cannaught Place to the narrow food-filled lanes of Jama Masjid, the high-end vibes of Khan Market, to the desi bazaar energy of Lajpat Nagar Market. I even visited  Jamia Millia Islamia University as a Guest Speaker.
So, get ready for a full Dilli darshan!

0:17 Cannaught Place
0:48 Janpath Market

1:35 Momos in Delhi

1:53 India Gate

7:29 My Husband 
7:50 Khan Market Delhi
8:10 Lajpat Nagar Market Delhi
8:40 Delhi Street Food

📍1. Connaught Place (CP) – Delhi’s Colonial Heartbeat
Explore the colonial charm of Connaught Place Delhi aka CP — a hub for shopping in Palika Bazar, relaxing in Central Park, and experiencing the top things to do in Connaught Place. A perfect mix of heritage and modern vibes.

🛍️2. Janpath Market – Trendy Shopping on a Budget
Head to Janpath Market Delhi for the ultimate budget shopping in Delhi! Find Kolhapuri chappals, silver jewellery, boho bags, and everything trendy at this iconic Janpath street market.

☕3. Depauls – Delhi’s OG Cold Coffee Spot Since 1952
Tucked inside Janpath Bhawan, Deepauls Janpath serves the best cold coffee in Delhi. A must-try hidden gem among Janpath food spots and classic hidden gems CP.

🛒4. Khan Market – Where Delhi’s Elite Hang Out
Discover Khan Market Delhi — perfect for luxury shopping in Delhi, sipping at the best cafés in Khan Market, and browsing through the best bookstores in Delhi. It’s where elegance meets heritage.

🇮🇳5. India Gate – A Tribute to India’s Bravery.
Witness the iconic India Gate night view and pay tribute at Amar Jawan Jyoti. A must-see Delhi landmark and one of the top must visit places in Delhi for tourists.

🧕6. Jama Masjid & Purani Dilli – Spiritual + Culinary Heaven
Feel the power of faith at Jama Masjid Delhi, followed by a mouth-watering Old Delhi food crawl. Watch me explore Jama Masjid street food and the best Muslim Halal food in Delhi.

🎓7. Jamia Millia Islamia University – A Campus Full of Culture
Jamia Millia Islamia University is one of the top Muslim universities in India, known for its rich history, academic excellence, and vibrant campus life. 
I was honored to be invited as a guest speaker at the Engineering Department’s Entrepreneurship Event, where I shared my content creator and business journey. The warm meet and greet with students and glimpses of Jamia campus life made this visit truly special.

🧣8. Lajpat Nagar Market – The Desi Fashion Hub
From Indian suits to readymade anarkalis, Lajpat Nagar shopping is a dream! Tried the famous Ram Laddoo in Lajpat Nagar.

This vlog is not just about tourism, it’s about reliving memories, discovering hidden gems, and falling in love with Delhi all over again.

snippet.description:
Join Veggie Paaji on an epic multi state food tour at Dilli Haat, INA, Delhi! In this video, we embark on a culinary journey to explore the diverse and authentic vegetarian cuisines from Jammu & Kashmir, Odisha, Maharashtra, and Sikkim, all under one roof.

Wazwan (Jammu & Kashmir Food Stall): Savor the rich flavors of Jammu Rajma Rice Thali [02:34], including authentic Baddarwah Rajma, flavorful Dam Aloo, and fried Paneer.

Maharashtra Food Stall (MTDC): Indulge in the rustic taste of Pithla Bhakri Thali [12:07] and refresh with a unique Kokam Sharbat [12:15]. Don't miss the creamy Shrikhand [12:14]!

Sikkim Tourism Tashi Delek Food Stall: Delight in perfectly steamed Veg Momos [17:23] served with a comforting clear soup.

This video is a celebration of India's incredible food diversity, providing an honest review and helping you navigate the best of Dilli Haat, INA.
